• Multiple instances of this work product may be necessary depending on the number of test levels required to test the target solution

  • A catalog of business users to support testing throughout all stages and participate in the user acceptance test (UAT) stage should be catalogued when planning for UAT

The purpose of this work product is perform the following:

  • To communicate how components of the target solution are tested
  • To coordinate testing activities among those involved in the test effort
  • To act as a central artifact that governs the planning of the test effort

A well-defined test approach minimizes risk of the following:

  • Poorly defined or inadequate planning for test
  • Delay in test execution increase due to cost and other inefficiencies
  • Subsequent difficulties in controlling the test phase of the project

The amount of information contained in this artifact varies from one project to the next based on factors such as duration, complexity and size of the test effort. Topics typically covered in this artifact include:

  • Test objectives and test types performed at each test level
  • Entry/exit criteria and acceptance thresholds
  • Testing responsibilities
  • Refined estimates for testing effort at each level
  • Test timelines and milestones
  • Test management approach
  • Defect management approach
  • Test reporting and communication approach
  • Considerations for training testers
